custody_chain: same-chip electrical region selections under provider lease
transfer_record_required: sample ID and physical chip ID
release_rule: Never infer receiver acceptance from sent request, attempted place, elapsed time, or empty command queue. Last accepted support/custodian remains responsible until receipt. Chip, subarray, reference Hall bar and secondary resistor IDs cannot be aliased.
condition_rules: Do not reopen or recondition sealed/protected sample as a recovery action
Provider preparation changes create a new process revision and invalidate dependent measurements as appropriate
Preserve pre-test condition, thermal/field exposure history and electrical over-limit flags
Unknown storage conditions or visible damage trigger supported quarantine and no further measurement request
